description: Create a Khipu payment (bank-transfer charge). Returns a payment_id and URLs the payer visits to authorize the transfer from their Chilean bank account. Use simplified_transfer_url for in-app redirects and transfer_url for desktop bank-login flows.

amount.description: Amount in major units (CLP has no decimals — 1000 = 1000 pesos)

body.description: Longer description of the payment (shown alongside subject)

cancel_url.description: Browser redirect target if the payer cancels

confirm_timeout_date.description: ISO-8601 deadline after which an unconfirmed payment auto-reverses

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code. Typically CLP for Chile; CLF supported for UF-denominated charges.

custom.description: Arbitrary merchant string (JSON-encoded if you need structure) echoed back in webhooks

expires_date.description: ISO-8601 expiration timestamp for this payment request

fixed_payer_personal_identifier.description: Lock this payment to a specific payer RUT

notify_api_version.description: Webhook API version. Use '3.0' for v3 notifications.

notify_url.description: Webhook URL Khipu POSTs to on status changes (receives a notification_token)

payer_email.description: Payer email — Khipu emails the payment instructions to this address

responsible_user_email.description: Internal merchant user email shown in Khipu's dashboard as responsible for this charge

return_url.description: Browser redirect target after a successful payment

send_email.description: If true, Khipu emails the payer with the payment link

send_reminders.description: If true, Khipu sends the payer reminder emails before expiration

subject.description: Short human-readable purpose of the payment (shown to the payer at their bank)

transaction_id.description: Merchant-side order reference echoed back in webhooks

name: create_payment
